## Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat

Session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Branch `claude/issue-7459-timeline-absent-axis-refusal`. Filed and dispatched in the same round, because the ruling on #7070 orders this card into existence and specifies its content — there is nothing left to triage before work can start.

File surface declared for cross-lane serialization: `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` and its tests. Checked against every open PR this lane holds — **no intersection**:

| PR | card | holds |
|---|---|---|
| #7447 | #6940 | `data-display.zod.ts`, the parity ledger |
| #7456 | #6939 group 1 | `overlay.zod.ts` |
| #7453 | #7071 | `plugin-calendar/ObjectCalendar.tsx` — **enqueued** |
| #7457 | #7088 | `types/base.ts` |
| (in flight) | #7344 | `app` / `reports` / `views` / `crud` / `complex` zod faces |
| (in flight) | #6939 group 6 | `objectql.zod.ts` |

`packages/plugin-timeline/` is held by nothing. ⚠️ Declared with the lesson from this shift attached: I once declared "no intersection" having checked exactly one open PR's file list, and the collision I missed would have had a dev write refusal arms for symbols another PR was deleting. The table above is every open PR in the lane, each read.

### Scope, restated for the record

⛔ Step ③ — deleting `'created_at'` at the two plugin faces — **is not in this dispatch**. It stays on #7070 and is blocked on this card landing. The brief carries that fence explicitly, because it is the one edit a dev in this file is most likely to make on momentum, and making it here would silently collapse a sequence the ruling deliberately ordered three steps deep.

⛔ flavour 3 (`progress` / `dependencies`) is likewise fenced out: the ruling forbids applying the date-axis conclusion to non-axis fields, and the measurement behind that is that a fabricated name there yields a per-row missing value rather than a wrong axis for the whole chart. Different defect, different question.

### The gate the brief puts first

The dev is told to re-measure both premises before implementing — the absent refusal path and the `?? 'date'` floor — rather than inheriting them from the #7070 report, which was taken on `2c3cd1b75` several days and many merges ago. Every line number in this card is stale by construction and the brief says so.

Clause ② expected **no** (the view layer stops inventing a field name; no published accept surface moves), re-declared against the actual diff. So this one is enqueueable by this seat once green — ⛔ unlike the Clause-② cards currently waiting on the project director seat.

State transition, same stroke: `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, assignee set.

## Closed — landed as `20cb8db9b` (PR #7467), verified by content on `origin/main`

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. `pm:dispatched` stripped.

### The readings

| probe | before (`177afeba1`) | `origin/main` |
|---|--:|--:|
| the fabricated `?? 'date'` floor | **1** | **0** |
| ⭐ CONTROL `startDateField`, same file | 12 | **18** |
| `data-testid="timeline-canvas"` | — | present |
| `noDateAxis` across the locale packs | — | **10** |
| ⛔ FENCE `created_at` — `plugin-list/ListView.tsx` | — | **4, unchanged** |
| ⛔ FENCE `created_at` — `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx` | — | **1, unchanged** |

The control rising 12 → 18 is what makes that zero a reading: a probe that had simply stopped matching would show the same 0 with a flat control.

⭐ And the tombstone comment in the shipped code is deliberately spelled so it does **not** quote the retired literal — the dev's reason, stated up front: a comment quoting it would make this very close-condition scan answer 1 where the truth is 0. That trap fired on this lane three separate times today; here it was designed out before it could.

### Steps ① and ② of the ruling are done; ③ is now unblocked

Ruling #7070, 总监批 #28 (comment 5494805467) sequences ① the refusal screen and ② the retired floor together — neither is observable alone — before ③. Both are on `main`, and the fence above proves ③ did **not** leak in early: the two `created_at` floors at the plugin faces are untouched at 4 and 1.

⇒ **#7070 step ③ is dispatched next.** House posture on record with that ruling: **日期轴永不虚构**.

### What this card actually bought

An object-bound timeline that declared no date axis used to resolve one anyway — a bare literal nobody had ever declared, sitting below the `created_at` the view faces supply. Every record then read a key its object does not carry, landed in the "No date" bucket, and the screen read as a timeline that had been built and simply had nothing in it. It now refuses, naming every binding it accepts.

⚠️ Blast radius, measured rather than assumed: **nothing in the product starts refusing.** Both plugin faces still supply `created_at` and app-shell routes through `ListView`, so the refusal is reached only by a view forced directly onto the renderer with nothing declared.

### One correction to this card that belongs in the record

The card and my dispatch both said *"four honest rungs, then a fabricated fifth."* The chain actually reads **five** declared bindings and a fabricated **sixth**. The dev re-derived it instead of trusting the count, checked the other five (all genuine declared bindings, no second fabrication), and reported the off-by-one without extending scope to "fix" anything. The error was mine.

⚠️ Also worth carrying: this PR sat red on `Bundle Analysis` for most of the shift, and **the red was its own** — one refusal string in ten locale packs, against a ceiling named `framework` that was in fact 78.7% translation catalogue. It went green with **not one byte of its copy changed** once #7399's option A′ (PR #7489) put those bytes on the right budget. I published three wrong causal stories about that ceiling before the measurement settled it; the record is on #7399.
